questions.prompt: Which record type maps a name to an IPv4 address?
What record type holds an IPv6 address? (four letters)
In `www.example.com. 3600 IN A 93.184.215.14`, what does 3600 mean?
options: Other servers may cache this record for up to 3600 seconds (one hour)

options: Makes one name an alias for another, canonical name
Maps an address back to a name
